name: Space-Filling Curve
desc: A Hilbert space-filling curve draws itself as one continuous glowing thread with a spectrum gradient running along its arclength, a luminous comet-head sweeping the lattice while the whole figure slowly rotates, breathes and undulates; renders as rainbow gradient-thread, CRT phosphor, cyan blueprint, gold PCB circuitry, or sumi ink on paper.

density.doc: curve order / lattice fineness (higher = deeper Hilbert order, denser weave)

scale.doc: figure size vs frame (higher = fills / overspills frame)

warp.doc: undulation / morph amplitude of the lattice

seed.doc: deterministic variation (rotation dir, hue offset, warp phase)
